style: Original instrumental action score for a painterly adventure game. Chamber orchestra and taiko, low strings, brass and driving percussion; modal harmony, tense and propulsive, no vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no bombast for its own sake. Steady tempo, immediate entrance, no long intro, loopable where noted.
negative: vocals, lyrics, choir, spoken word, rap, EDM drop, trailer drums, distorted electric guitar, saxophone solo, cheesy synth lead

cues.name: Skirmish
cues.mood: Tense, agile, immediate. Pizzicato strings, taiko and short brass hits; quick encounter energy.
cues.prompt: A fast skirmish: 140 BPM, pizzicato strings, taiko and short brass hits, tense but agile.

cues.name: Ambush
cues.mood: Sudden, sharp, dangerous. Low-string hits and irregular taiko with brass stabs.
cues.prompt: An ambush: 120 BPM, sudden low-string hits, irregular taiko and sharp brass, danger.

cues.name: Chase
cues.mood: Relentless, forward-driving. Ostinato strings, taiko and low brass.
cues.prompt: A chase: 150 BPM, driving ostinato in strings, taiko and low brass, relentless.

cues.name: Boss
cues.mood: Immense, threatening, ceremonial weight. Heavy low brass, taiko and dissonant strings.
cues.prompt: A boss: 100 BPM, heavy low brass, taiko and dissonant strings, immense and threatening.

cues.name: Victory
cues.mood: Relief and triumph. Rising brass, strings and cymbals; brief rather than bombastic.
cues.prompt: A short victory: 120 BPM, brass and strings rising, cymbals, relief and triumph.

cues.name: Stealth
cues.mood: Sparse, watchful, breath-held. Low pulse, plucked strings and small hits.
cues.prompt: Stealth tension: 80 BPM, sparse low pulse, plucked strings, breath and small hits, cautious.

cues.name: Storm
cues.mood: Surging, exposed, maritime danger. Wind, low drums and rising strings.
cues.prompt: A storm: 100 BPM, wind, low drums and surging strings, environmental danger.

cues.name: Volcano
cues.mood: Awe and danger. Low brass, taiko and dissonant strings; enormous, not horror.
cues.prompt: A volcanic eruption: 90 BPM, low brass, taiko and dissonant strings, awe and danger.

cues.name: Race
cues.mood: Galloping, competitive, bright-edged. Strings, horns and drums at full stride.
cues.prompt: A race final stretch: 160 BPM, galloping strings and horns, drums, competitive.

cues.name: Ritual
cues.mood: Ceremonial and intense. Temple bell, slow taiko and low strings.
cues.prompt: A bell ritual: 70 BPM, temple bell, slow taiko and low strings, ceremonial and intense.

cues.name: Revelation
cues.mood: Wonder edged with unease. Rising strings, harp and a restrained brass statement.
cues.prompt: A revelation: 90 BPM, rising strings, harp and brass, wonder and unease.

cues.name: Defeat
cues.mood: Quiet falling motion. Slow strings, low piano and a single sustained line.
cues.prompt: A defeat: 60 BPM, slow strings, low piano and a quiet falling line, loss.
